name: orion-knowledge-atlas
description: Browse, summarize, cite, and edit your local Orion Spaces from Claude.
long_description: A local bridge between Claude Desktop and Orion. Discover projects and workspaces, browse the active Space by default, read its living overview, search one Space at a time, open citation links in Orion, retrieve bounded source evidence, and directly create, edit, or delete notes without cloud sync or an API key.

tools.name: orion_list_spaces
tools.description: Discover, list, browse, open, or switch between Orion projects, workspaces, and knowledge Spaces; returns valid Space IDs and content counts.

tools.name: orion_browse_space
tools.description: Browse, read, or open the active Orion Space by default, or an explicit Space; returns its living-overview preview and note index.

tools.name: orion_search
tools.description: Search, find, or look up notes and concepts within one Orion project or knowledge Space.

tools.name: orion_get_note
tools.description: Read, open, or retrieve a note with its concepts, sources, connections, and Orion citation.

tools.name: orion_get_source
tools.description: Read, open, or retrieve bounded extracted evidence from an Orion source.

tools.name: orion_get_space_summary
tools.description: Read or summarize the active Orion project's living overview for orientation, then use underlying notes and sources for detailed or cited answers.

tools.name: orion_create_note
tools.description: Write, add, create, and immediately save an ordinary note in one explicit Space.

tools.name: orion_update_note
tools.description: Write, edit, update, and immediately save supplied fields on an existing note in one explicit Space.

tools.name: orion_delete_note
tools.description: Delete a note and clean its Space-scoped references.
